content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, and I just have a couple of quick requests regarding the terms before I sign.

- Regarding the intellectual property clause: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation or delivery, rather than upon receipt of full payment, which means you could lose your work without being paid. Please modify this so that all deliverables developed under this Agreement shall belong to the Client upon full payment of all applicable fees due for such work.
- Regarding the termination clause: The client can terminate the agreement immediately without liability if a conflict of interest is raised, leaving you without compensation for completed work. Please update this so that in the event of termination due to a conflict of interest, the Client shall pay for all services rendered and expenses incurred up to the date of termination.

Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to getting started.

Best regards
